replacement.statement: The product shall require an additional authentication factor when policy requires it.
replacement.rationale: The updated security policy requires multi-factor authentication.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A policy-bound user cannot establish a session using only one factor.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Execute an end-to-end test for a user governed by the multi-factor policy.

modifications.reason: Require multi-factor authentication for policy-bound users.

assumptions: The policy source can identify users subject to multi-factor authentication.
risks: Existing clients may not support the additional challenge.
